method: Independent complete Hebrew/Aramaic–English comparison of all five manually selected source units. Hebrew Etz Yosef consulted for Vayikra Rabbah 9:3. Existing independent source-selection audit and root approvals retained; no legacy English used for translation assessment.

Divine subject through the separation/placement clauses is a grammatical inference from the continuous explicit subject; no unattested Sulam authority claimed. Exact selected source is Bereshit 24:260; public broader label remains unchanged.
Complete seven-word ruling faithfully rendered, including the comparative preference and intention qualification.

Complete approved opening argument through the first conclusion retained, with every supplied proof verse, David’s declarations about kingship/might/wealth, and attribution of victory and formation for battle. No later Goliath narrative imported.

Complete story and concluding teachings retained. Hebrew Etz Yosef independently read to verify the appraisal wordplay, clothing, cup, dog statement and reporting to the subject of an ill word. All four knowledge tests, inheritance argument, peacemaking, 26 generations and divine/Israel salvation conclusion remain.

Complete source paragraph and exact qualifications retained, including the circumstance of inability to resist otherwise, the atonement requirement, sitting in ice in winter or fasting forty days in summer. This review confirms historical textual fidelity, without turning the quoted ruling into new practical advice.
